subject: ventures/sales-agent
professional: a sales-operations lead / SDR manager who runs cold outreach for a small B2B team, with a deliverability and email-compliance specialist checking the pre-send, auth and ramp checkers

evidence.correctness: Ran probes through engine.triage(reply,'2026-11-09'), sendramp.plan and presend.presend. Independent recomputation in Python: (1) plan({mailboxes:3,targetPerDay:100}) -> daysToTarget 16, firstWeekTotal 285, schedule 30x3,45x3,60x3,75x3,90x3,100; a separate Python loop of the stated rule (start 10, +5 every 3 days, cap 40, 3 boxes, cap at target) gave 16 days and 285. (2) plan({mailboxes:2,targetPerDay:50}) -> 10 days, 25/box; hand check 10+5*3=25 per box. (3) Dates against Python calendar: 'out of office until Monday 16 November' (today 2026-11-09) -> 2026-11-16 (a Monday); 'Out of office. Back in 2 wks' -> 2026-11-23 (= 2026-11-09 + 14 days); 'try me again in March 2027' -> 2027-03-01. (4) presend US body 'we work with 20000 firms. Reply unsubscribe' now gives a postal-address error (the 2026-11-07 high defect, a bare 5-digit number passing, is fixed); country 'Germany' resolves to the DE consent regime. Negation: "Please don't unsubscribe me, I love this!" and "Do not remove me from your list" now triage as unclear/weak (were unsubscribe/clear on 2026-11-08), a fix; 'stop emailing me' and 'Remove me from your list' still unsubscribe/clear. Remaining wrong outputs: 'back 12/11/2026' -> 2026-12-11 and 'back 3/4/2027' -> 2027-03-04, month-first with no locale signal or ambiguity flag; "I'm not interested, but please don't remove me" -> not_interested/clear with no note on the keep-me request (acceptable, no suppression); 'Can you stop by next week?' -> question/weak (was interested/weak). I did not run a SPF recompute beyond the mutation test.
evidence.completeness: Checked by running: inbox triage (10 categories), daily run, call prep, follow-up, research agent, pre-send checker, sequence checker, warm-up planner, list cleaner, auth checker, suppression reader all have modules with passing tests; self-host/ passes 25/25. README and ROADMAP say plainly that self-host, SMTP, OAuth, CRM write-back, voice are tested on fakes only and that M2 model scores and M5 are open. I could not load the live page https://marisstella.app/sales-agent/ (no browser), so 'live tool' is checked only through page.test.mjs. Everything described works end to end on synthetic input, nothing on real mail: 3, capped by that disclosed gap.
evidence.verification: cd ventures/sales-agent && node --test '*.test.mjs': 226 tests, 226 pass, 1.3 s (219 on 2026-11-08). self-host: 25/25 pass. Mutation 1 (engine.mjs addBusinessDays 'w !== 0 && w !== 6' -> 'w !== 0'): 1 failed of 226, caught. Mutation 2 (authcheck.mjs 'lookups > 10' -> '> 11'): 1 failed, caught. Both reverted with git checkout, git status clean. Weakness: tests mostly pin author-written fixtures; fresh eval sets get spent once tuned on (README says so); only one test killed each mutation (thin redundancy).
evidence.craft: Read sendramp.mjs, presend.mjs, authcheck.mjs (SPF section), engine.mjs date and triage regions. Good: pure functions, input validation in plan() (need()), shared suppression reader, no send path. Defects: engine.mjs is ~770 lines of regex rule tables with dated 'added after N misses' patches (overfit by construction, the ROADMAP's tuned vs fresh gap); numeric dates are locale-blind; triage(reply, today) still requires a YYYY-MM-DD string and gives an opaque error otherwise (carried over from 11-08, unchanged); presend.mjs is a single big function with a regex-based postal-address and opt-out test (the opt-out regex matches the word 'unsubscribe' anywhere in the body, carried over from 11-07); authcheck SPF counting does not expand includes (stated in the warning text).
evidence.claims: Checked: 'no send path, a test fails if one appears' (page.test.mjs, passes); test counts consistent with the run; bounce corpus figure labelled as tuned and NOTICE files present; fresh-set rules scores stated low, not inflated; presend/authcheck/sendramp say rules of thumb, from memory, not legal advice. Gaps: llms.txt still links the retired github.io host rather than marisstella.app (redirect pages exist, so links resolve, but it is stale); README does not say numeric dates are month-first; the 'why use this instead' comparison with 11x/Artisan/Outreach is not backed by evidence about those products; live page not loaded by me. Honest overall: 3.
evidence.fitness: Job walked through by running probes: a founder pastes replies, gets categories, a suppression record with the sentence, paused dates and drafts for approval; works, and the false-suppression-of-negated-opt-out hazard from 11-08 is now closed. But headline accuracy on text the rules have not seen is 37.5 to 66% (own eval), M2 model path is unmeasured, nothing has run on a real mailbox/CRM/call, and a dd/mm date from a European contact would pause a prospect up to weeks wrong with no flag. A useful reviewed sorter, not a trusted agent: 2. Free checkers (pre-send, list, auth, ramp) are usable standalone.
evidence.domain: Compared against CAN-SPAM (opt-out and physical address), CASL/PECR/UWG consent regimes, RFC 7208 (10-lookup limit), RFC 7489 and Google/Yahoo bulk-sender rules. Method (stop on ambiguity, suppress with quoted sentence, drafts only, 10-lookup SPF limit, 2% bounce stop) is what a deliverability specialist would endorse. Departures: compliance text is written from memory with primary sources unread and no lawyer review; ramp defaults (10/day, +5 per 3 days, cap 40) are folklore and unmeasured; the ramp warns on complaints at 0.1% but Google's hard line is 0.3% (conservative, fine); the opt-out check accepts the word 'unsubscribe' anywhere; reply classification below a practitioner's trust threshold until M2 is measured.

defects.what: All-numeric dates are parsed month-first with no locale signal or ambiguity flag ('back 12/11/2026' -> 2026-12-11, 'back 3/4/2027' -> 2027-03-04); a European contact meaning 12 November is paused about four weeks too long and the user is not told it was a guess.

Pre-send opt-out check passes if 'unsubscribe', 'opt out', 'remove me' etc. appears anywhere in the body, not as an instruction to the reader; compliance text per country is from memory, statutes unread, no lawyer review.
Reply accuracy on unseen text is low (rules 27/41, 37.5% on fresh sets per the project's eval); M2 model scores unmeasured; no component has run on real mail, a real CRM or a real call.
llms.txt page links still point to the retired github.io host instead of https://marisstella.app/sales-agent/ (carried over from 2026-11-07).
triage() requires today as a YYYY-MM-DD string; other types give an opaque RangeError ('Invalid time value') rather than a clear message (carried over from 2026-11-08).
SPF lookup count does not expand includes (stated in the warning); DKIM key size inferred from base64 length and skipped for ed25519.

verdict: Changes since 2026-11-08: tests 219 -> 226 all passing, the negated-opt-out false suppression is fixed ("don't unsubscribe me" -> unclear, a human reviews it), and since 11-07 the bare-5-digit postal-address hole is fixed and the pre-send checker now reads country names. Both seeded mutations (weekend rule in addBusinessDays, SPF lookup limit) were caught and reverted. Recomputed ramp plan (16 days, 285 first week), 2-week OOO date and weekday date all matched an independent Python calculation. It meets the computed bar narrowly (correctness, claims, verification all 3), with craft, fitness and domain at 2: reply sorting is regex tables the project itself measures at 37.5 to 66% on unseen text, month-first numeric dates are still unflagged, compliance rules are from memory, and nothing has touched a real mailbox, CRM or call. Finished as described on synthetic input (completeness 3). Live page not loaded.
